description:
16+year Law Enforcement Veteran & Detective-Owned Company

- InterNACHI Certified Professional Inspector

- ICA Certified Home Inspector

- CCPIA Certified Commercial Property Inspector

- FAA Certified Drone Pilot 

- NRPP Certified Radon Measurement Professional (RMP)

COLORADO CATHOLIC DISCOUNT: Védeni Property Inspections, LLC provides home inspection services for homebuyers in the Denver and Colorado Front Range area and offers discounts through the Colorado Catholic Business Network. Please mention CCBN or use promo code CCBN when booking online! 

Additional Services: 
*Sewer Scope Inspections 
*Professional Radon Testing 

We aim to be a one-stop shop for all of your inspection needs, to provide a trusted and ethical Catholic-friendly service. 

Visit us online at www.vedenipro.com for more information or to book online. 

Védeni Property Inspections, LLC is a family-owned Catholic business guided by the words of Hebrews 13:14: 

“For this world is not our permanent home; we are looking forward to a home yet to come.”
